1.why: The interface features a static, clean layout with no moving images, animations, or pop-up windows across all seven steps.

2.why: Primary action buttons are prominently styled with solid dark blue fill, and active steps are clearly highlighted in the progress sidebar.

3.why: The clear two-column layout visually separates progress navigation, main actions, and help features, making content easy to locate.

4.why: The sidebar tracks progress visually and Step 4 explicitly lists a bulleted password checklist so users do not need to memorize rules.

5.why: No password manager options, autofill prompts, or 'remember me' checkboxes are visible on any of the input forms.

6.why: Step 1 explicitly displays the user's approved account identifier in a green callout box so it can be recognized easily.

7.why: Text is broken into short, high-contrast sentences, bold headings, and easily readable bullet points throughout.

8.why: No error messages or validation error states are present or demonstrated in any of the seven screenshots.

9.why: Step 1 provides an explicit sample identifier (helena.demo@hospital.test) to demonstrate what to type in the field.

10.why: Options between password sign-in, recovery code verification, and simulated delivery links are clearly presented and labeled.

11.why: Each screen focuses strictly on a single sub-task with only one or two main action buttons available at a time.

12.why: Green notification boxes appear on every step to explicitly state the status and result of the user's previous action.

13.why: A dedicated 'Help and safe sign-in' section with contextual tips and a reminder button is continuously present on every step.

14.why: The interface includes explicit 'Back to recovery request', 'Pause and return later', and 'Resume recovery' options to correct course.

15.why: The two-column layout, color palette, typography, progress bar, and help panel placement remain identical across all seven screens.
